How scoring and squad selection work
01 / THE HAUL

Get home safely.

Battery = 1. Music box = 2. Pocket Sun = 3. Only treasures banked through your home door count.

02 / THE RECORD

Treasure, then time.

Your best run counts. A bigger haul always wins; equal hauls use exact game ticks. Equal results share a rank.

03 / THE SQUAD

Three escapes make a team.

Top three qualifiers enter each squad. Their final hauls add together, then their times. All three must bank a run.

Attempts, ties and rehearsal limits

Each seat has 10 attempts per round. The attempt starts when you press Play inside the game. Retrying or leaving an active run consumes it. Practice is unlimited. A tie across the third qualifier spot needs another run before squads lock.

This rehearsal has manual round controls, no deadline and no connection recovery. Pausing stops the game clock. Results are editable browser data, not verified competition. No wallet, live membership, prize pool or payout is connected.

Rehearsal controls & limitations
